value.rationale: The theorem is a complete structural C2/stable-equitable classification in an infinite natural family of finite polar geometries, with a sharp parity transition: odd rank permanently merges geometric stabilizer orbits, whereas even rank at least four recovers all of them in exactly three rounds regardless of field size or rank. It isolates the responsible nontrivial symmetric-nullity cancellation and gives exact class and quotient counts; this goes beyond simply reproving existing matrix census or distance-regularity.
